name: ImagingStudyIdentifier
label: Imaging study identifier
description: The user- or equipment-generated identifier of an instance of a study entity. (NCIT:C164493)

name: BelongsToPerson
label: Belongs to person
description: Reference to the person whom this imaging study is about. (NCIT:C164337)

name: BelongsToDiagnosis
label: Belongs to diagnosis
description: Reference to the specific clinical examination, diagnosis, or disease timepoint during which this imaging study was indicated or evaluated. (SIO:000068)

name: StudyDate
label: Study date
description: The date on which a study began. (NCIT:C69208)

name: ImagingProcedure
label: Imaging procedure
description: An imaging procedure as defined by SNOMED CT, representing a specific diagnostic or acquisition procedure (e.g., 'CT of breast', 'MRI of head', or 'Whole Slide Imaging'), rather than the general modality or technique alone. The general modality or technique (e.g., 'CT', 'MR', 'SM') is captured separately in the 'Imaging modality' field. (NCIT:C17369)

name: ReasonForImagingProcedure
label: Reason for imaging procedure
description: The clinical or research rationale for performing the imaging procedure. This field captures why the procedure was indicated for the patient, such as screening, diagnosis, treatment planning, or research purposes. It should express the intent or medical reason, not the technical details of the procedure itself. (NCIT:C69216)

name: SeriesCount
label: Series count
description: The total number of image series contained within this imaging study. (NCIT:C164492)

name: ImagesCount
label: Images count
description: The total number of individual image instances or frames comprising this imaging study. (NCIT:C164540)

name: AffiliatedInstitution
label: Affiliated institution
description: The organisation or institution responsible for performing the imaging study. (NCIT:C25412)
